current.text: Caruso is projected as OKC's seventh man. He is not expected to play enough minutes to matter in fantasy and is only worth using as a steals streamer.
OKC traded away Lu Dort, Aaron Wiggins and Isaiah Joe this offseason. Caruso and Jalen Williams are the only wings left on the roster who can guard bigger forwards.
OKC is projected to win about 57 to 62 games and to be a top two seed in the West.
OKC has a league-minimum 13 back-to-backs. Its schedule is good for a season that ends March 28.

durable.text: Steals are his main fantasy asset, and he commits few turnovers. He scores very little, even for his position.

tags.name: good playoff schedule
tags.detail: Schedule is good with a March 28 end date

note: Caruso should go undrafted in our 144-player auction. Both sites price him at 0 USD, Yahoo ranks him 202 and ESPN ranks him 136, and he was not drafted in our league last season. As a seventh man, he is a waiver streamer for steals (projected 1.6 per game, z +1.9 against the pool) and low turnovers, and he fits punt PTS builds best. Early in the season, watch whether OKC's thin wing depth gets him more than his 2025-26 average of 18 minutes.
